blindness.rule: Blind pass/fail code contains no historical Maxwell stress coefficient, no m_e/e target, and no SST circulation target. Raw source paths and human-readable carrier/provider identities are not written to blind result ledgers; requested topology IDs may remain visible in the frozen preregistration.

pklsa_admission.note: A topology-level aggregate failure does not automatically exclude an individually qualified carrier. Such a carrier supports only a carrier-specific result, never a topology-class claim.

decision_rule.FAIL: Any failed mandatory M6/M7 or PKLSA-source-integrity gate falsifies that tested closure on the admitted carrier set. M1-M3 stress failures falsify the tested coarse-grained stress surrogate only.
decision_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: No admissible carrier, missing multicomponent evidence when required, or insufficient resolved reach blocks the corresponding claim.
decision_rule.PASS: The preregistered carrier-level topology/circulation and enabled stress gates pass. This neither upgrades PKLSA's global publication status nor establishes an SST particle claim.
